description: This source file contains functions for exporting observation data and events in various formats, including tabular, aggregated, and sequence representations, for the BORIS behavioral observation software. It handles file writing, data formatting, and interaction with external modules for database and media info.

methods.name: export_events_jwatcher
methods.description: Exports events in jwatcher .dat format for each subject, creating associated .fmf, .faf, and .fma files with behavior data and metadata.

methods.name: export_tabular_events
methods.description: Exports detailed event data for a specific observation in various formats, including CSV, TSV, HTML, or pandas DataFrame, with options for media info and modifiers.

methods.name: dataset_write
methods.description: Writes a tablib dataset to a file in specified format, supporting pandas, RDS, CSV, TSV, HTML, ODS, XLS, and XLSX formats.

methods.name: export_aggregated_events
methods.description: Exports aggregated event data for an observation, optionally forcing number of modifiers, and adjusts event times within specified intervals.

methods.name: events_to_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Generates a behavioral sequence string for a subject in an observation, based on event start/stop points.

methods.name: events_to_behavioral_sequences_all_subj
methods.description: Generates behavioral sequences for all subjects in an observation, with subject labels.

methods.name: events_to_timed_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Creates a time-sampled behavioral sequence string for a subject with specified precision.

methods.name: observation_to_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Exports behavioral sequences for selected observations to a text file, including metadata and detailed event info.
